sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Marketing Skills is a library of skills for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Each skill is a Markdown file that teaches the agent a marketing task, such as SEO audits, conversion optimisation, copywriting, A/B testing, ads or churn prevention.
sixtySeconds.problem: General AI agents give generic marketing advice. These skills give them proven frameworks and checklists for specific jobs, and all of them start from a shared product-marketing skill so the advice fits your product and audience.
whoFor: Founders doing their own growth work
Developers building landing pages and funnels
Teams using Claude Code or Codex for marketing tasks
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a large, organised, MIT-licensed set of marketing skills that cross-reference each other and install with one command.
requirements: An AI coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor

overview: Skills are grouped into areas: SEO and content, CRO, content and copy, paid ads and measurement, growth and retention, sales and go-to-market, and strategy. The product-marketing skill is the foundation that every other skill reads first.

Install everything or only the skills you want with the npx skills CLI, which detects your agents and installs into .claude/skills for Claude Code or .agents/skills for others. Claude Code users can also add it as a plugin marketplace.

A separate guided setup in tools/SETUP.md connects your marketing accounts with scoped credentials. The library is free and MIT licensed; verified partner tools are disclosed and listed alongside neutral options.
